claim: testcontainers-python had no Mosquitto/MQTT module until issue #568 (May 2024) requested one for an MQTT-publishing Home Assistant alarm project, and the issue was closed with the class added after community contribution.
stance_target: first-class MQTT-broker-in-tests support is a recent, thinly-maintained facility across language ecosystems — ha-linux-agent cannot assume a rich harness exists
quoted_support: I'm writing integration tests for a Python project (https://github.com/f18m/ha-alarm-raspy2mqtt) that publishes messages to an MQTT broker. I would like to use testcontainers to create the integration tests and noticed that there is no specialization available for MQTT and for its most-used broker which is Mosquitto.

claim: The Mosquitto test-container request was labelled 'enhancement' + 'contributions are welcome', with the requester offering to provide his own implementation — evidence of community-driven, not vendor-driven, maintenance.
stance_target: risk assessment of relying on community MQTT test tooling for a fleet-wide agent
quoted_support: I can provide a PR to add my own MosquittoContainer implementation if there is interest by the project maintainers...
